name: Wufa Chuanda de Huayu
source:
When will this love be conveyed to you?

In the last year of high school, I want to convey this feeling to you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897270/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这份爱什么时候才能传达给你呢？

在高中的最后一年，我想把这种感觉传达给你们。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897270/]Steam[/url]]
